incident-bot: RCA published for incident 'cache-repack-rebalance-regression' — https://intranet.redwood/rca/1782006789
Brief: frequent shard reshuffle from the new repack daemon caused repeated cache warmup and a spike in 99th latency for hosted text-generation endpoints (~2.5 hours). Root cause: aggressive shard consolidation + missing jitter in repack schedule. Rollback: reverted repack rollout and temporarily disabled consolidation flag.

Priya: RCA is live. Please review the 'Remediations' and 'Owners' sections. Top items: 1) runtime: add incremental warming to reduce cold miss penalty (Dima) 2) infra: add jitter and backoff to repack schedule (Luis) 3) monitoring: create a 99th-latency canary + cache-miss rate dashboard (Rachel).

Dima: Taking runtime incremental warming. ETA Wed EOD. Will add a configurable warmup window + soft-eviction. Any perf budget constraints?

Luis: I'll push repack jitter + pause-on-consolidation flag today. Planning to add a 5-20s random jitter and exponential backoff after a repack event. PR later today.

Rachel: I'll add a nightly canary that runs small-batch traffic against a pinned model and emits 95/99 pct. Also creating a dashboard tile for cache-miss-rate by shard.

Priya: Minimal repro we've used in perf lab:
```
# mini repro to create shard churn
wrk -t8 -c200 -d300s --latency https://perf.internal/generate -s scripts/burst_small_batch.lua
```
This reproduces the rapid small-batch bursts that triggered reshuffles.

Jacob: Scheduling a 45m follow-up checkpoint Friday 09:30 UTC to validate warmup telemetry and the canary. Calendar invite sent.

Dima: Branch created with warmup patch: https://git.redwood/repo/456. Running CI and a perf run now.

Luis: Repack jitter PR: https://git.redwood/repo/457 — adds jitter + a "pause_after_repack" flag defaulting to 10m.

Rachel: Canary and dashboard PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/458. Alerts: inc if 99th latency > 150ms for 3m or cache-miss-rate > 5% for 5m.

Priya: Action items tracked: https://kanban.redwood/board/rca-1782006789. Please update progress and move cards when PRs merge. We'll mark incident channel archived after Friday checkpoint if things look stable.

Luis: Early signals look promising after rollback — tail latency back to baseline. Continuing to monitor.

Priya: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. If you see any regressions, ping @Priya and @Jacob. :white_check_mark:
